system.description:
Once per encounter, as part of the action you use to attack, your first attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits, with no rolling.

  • 13th level: every attack that turn has Advantage and deals maximum damage if it hits
  • 20th level: lasts 1 minute, and enemies that can see you must make a Will save (Class Save DC) at the start of each of their turns or be frightened for 1 round

rules.value: Legend of Battle: {1:your first attack this turn deals maximum damage if it hits, 13:every attack this turn deals maximum damage if it hits}.
